training.interpretation: training log only; not held-out or quality evidence

teacher_validation.uncertainty_scope: Descriptive per-class clusters only. Each image and noise is reused at 10 assigned times; no independent-row CI.
teacher_validation.guarantee_scope: Teacher interpolation regression only; no actual-midpoint velocity target, population KL, or FID claim.

empirical_squared_mean_gap.contribution_scope: All 100 fixed times retained; ranked contributions are descriptions, not a selected time window.

second1024_empirical_squared_mean_gap.contribution_scope: All 100 fixed times retained; ranked contributions are descriptions, not a selected time window.

offdiagonal_cross_statistic.contribution_scope: All 100 fixed times retained; ranked contributions are descriptions, not a selected time window.

finite_teacher_map_moments.scope: Fixed heterogeneous class/image cohort; off-diagonal cross statistic is not claimed unbiased for a population squared mean gap and can be negative.
finite_teacher_map_moments.split_limitation: The archive stores only all-2048-dimensional squared_delta_sum. First/second 1024 empirical mean gaps can be split, but their separate off-diagonal cross statistics cannot be reconstructed.

actual_rollout.scope: 96 actual rollouts, 32 fixed classes. All moments describe visited states; no true X, denoising risk, decoded image, or FID. Timing includes FP64 moments and copies.

train.outer_boundary_note: Original driver/session disappeared after the final training artifacts were written. Return code and exact perf_counter outer wall were not captured. Bounds use UTC timestamps and the later absence observation, not a recovered monotonic elapsed measurement.

inherited_bank_cost.boundary: existing bank creation summary; earlier source selection/history costs not fully timed; no total-cost success claim

costs.scope: Joint research ledger includes both fitted fields and controls. Shared teacher/data costs are not halved. Prior source-selection/history costs and original training outer completion are not fully measured; no complete amortized-cost or deployment-speed claim.

scope: Descriptive mechanism pilot. No independent-row confidence intervals, unbiased-population cross-statistic claim, KL guarantee for finite learned solver, or generation-quality conclusion.
